besluite.fout: 'gemaak' is vague in a block about who invented something
besluite.rede: 'uitgevind' is the exact verb for an inventor, matches the next sentence, and leaves the protected sentence untouched.

besluite.fout: 'klink na een woord' is illogical, since televisie is one word that only appears to be a single unit
besluite.rede: 'lyk soos een woord' says clearly that it appears to be one word but has two parts, with no change to what is claimed.
'nie geskik vir kinders nie' is already natural Afrikaans, so moving the phrase is a lateral change.

besluite.fout: under the house AWS rule a comma before 'en' joining parts of one sentence is not allowed, though it can be defended as a contrast comma
besluite.rede: This is a glossary definition that may be shared, and a defensible contrast comma is not a plain error, so the writer has to change it in every lesson at once.
